title: Journey into Nyx Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The night-sky realm said to belong to the gods of Theros.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane whose skies the Dawnbringer Charioteers claim as their own.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: A god of Theros, twin of Mogis, said to differ from him in appearance and personality.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: A god of Theros, twin of Iroas, said to differ from him in appearance and personality.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: A god of Theros whose forge sends out sparks that fill the belly of every dragon.

relations.note: Nyx is the gods' realm, set against the skies of Theros
relations.quote: Nyx may belong to the gods, but the skies of Theros are ours.
Iroas and Mogis are as different in appearance as they are in personality.
